text.p: Littlefield, Adams & Co said Wednesday it received a proposal on behalf of Michael Blumenfeld to invest $1 million through the purchase of newly issued common at a price of $1.50 per share.
The company said the offer will be considered by its directors along with any others received.
Blumenfeld is the founder and former chief executive of Sport Supply Group Inc, Littlefield said.
In addition to common, the company said, Blumenfeld also sought five year warrants to purchase an additional 500,000 common shares at $2 per share.
Upon completion of the proposed private placement, Blumenfeld proposed, he would be named chief executive of Littlefield and designate a majority of the board.
The company said the offer remains open through April 8 and is subject only to acceptance by directors before the deadline and five days due diligence.
